executive_summary: Overall performance shows potential but with high volatility sa spend at inconsistent lead flow. Sa July, gumastos tayo ng total na ₱2,742.04 na nag-generate ng 34 messages. Medyo mataas ang CPC (average ~₱8-₱12) dahil sa mga campaigns na hindi naka-optimize. Ang reach ay nasa 6,440 impressions na may average CTR na nasa 3% to 4%. Kelangan natin mag-focus sa mas stable na delivery para bumaba ang cost-per-message (CPM) na minsan ay sumisipa hanggang ₱300+ sa mahinang days.
best_campaigns: 📁 2026 | Leads | Multi Models | JULY (id: 120247833797450625) - Best CPM and efficient messaging conversion.
worst_campaigns: JULY ADS 2026 (id: 120247367057580625) - Masyadong malaki ang fluctuation sa cost-per-message (up to ₱300+).
winning_ads: 🚗 02 - Mirage G4 | ₱15K+/Month (id: 120247840980830625) - Consistent CTR and low cost-per-message.
creative_insights: Video ads are performing better than static images sa conversion rate. Mas mataas ang engagement kapag pinapakita ang actual unit or short testimonial clip. Yung mga 'Zero Down, 2 Months Free' na headline ang pinaka-effective sa audience.
historical_insights: Trends show na mas mura ang cost-per-message kapag mas mahaba ang duration ng campaign (avoiding learning phase reset). Dati, ang L300 campaigns ay stable nung Q1 2026, dapat balikan ang strategy na yun for the business segment.

best_locations: Las Piñas, Parañaque, Muntinlupa (Metro South focus is key for Citimotors catchment), Cavite areas (Bacoor/Imus) are high-intent areas.
best_interests: Car financing, BPI/BDO/PSBank Auto Loan, Small Business Owners (for L300), Transport/Logistics/Ride-hailing groups.
market_demand_notes: Mitsubishi Mirage G4 is our top entry-level volume driver. L300 remains the king for business/logistics. Xpander continues to be the family favorite; keep messaging focused on 'Low DP/Easy Monthly' for these units.
